name: Goblin
description: Small, vicious humanoids that gather in larger numbers and rely on cunning, ambush, and dirty tactics. Most goblins live in dim caves or fortified camps.

name: Wolf
description: Pack hunter with keen hearing and smell. Wolves attack by biting and toppling targets, taking advantage of pack tactics for advantage on attacks against creatures within 5 feet of an ally.

name: Bandit
description: Common highway robber or sellsword. Wields a scimitar and a light crossbow. Travels in groups led by a bandit captain.

name: Skeleton
description: Animated remains of a fallen warrior. Vulnerable to bludgeoning damage; immune to poison and exhaustion. Often equipped with a shortsword and shortbow.

name: Zombie
description: Slow-moving animated corpse. Undead Fortitude lets it shrug off damage that would drop it to 0 HP if it succeeds on a Constitution saving throw.

name: Ogre
description: Brutish giants that prowl wilderness areas, hunting for food and treasure. Wielding a greatclub for crushing strikes and a javelin for ranged attacks.

name: Young Red Dragon
description: Greedy, fire-breathing menace. The young red dragon uses Multiattack (one bite + two claws) and a recharging fire breath that fills a 30-foot cone with searing flame.

name: Kobold
description: Small reptilian humanoids that fight with cunning rather than strength. Pack Tactics gives them advantage on attacks against creatures within 5 feet of an ally.
